---
title: "Nonprofit Density: Data and Multiverse"
subtitle: "Replication files, data workflow and multiverse analysis"
author: "Jesse Lecy and Jeremy P. Thornton"
---

This site documents the database behind our study of nonprofit density in US counties
and metropolitan areas, 2000–2024, and the multiverse analysis built on it. It is
written for researchers who want to reproduce or extend the work, and for local
foundations and governments that want a defensible way to assess and strengthen their
nonprofit sectors.

| Part | What it covers |
|---|---|
| [0. Motivation](site/00-motivation.qmd) | Why measure nonprofit density, and why do it as a multiverse |
| [1. Literature review](site/01-literature.qmd) | Nonprofit density, urban scaling and SAMIs, multiverse analysis |
| [2. Dataset construction](site/02-construction.qmd) | Units, outcomes, covariates, build stages, known breaks |
| [3. Files, sources and dictionaries](site/03-files-sources.qmd) | Every data source with citation and licence, the frozen-file manifest, variable dictionaries |
| [4. Workflow code](site/04-workflow.qmd) | Restoring inputs, running the build step by step, checking the result |
| [5. Multiverse overview](paper/03-multiverse-overview.qmd) | Why a multiverse, the specification grid, attributing spread to decisions |
| [6. Multiverse design](paper/04-design-decisions.qmd) | Decision cards D1–D12; [variables and constructs](paper/02-variables.qmd) |
| [7. Stylized facts](paper/01-stylized-facts.qmd) | Seven regularities in density data |
| [8. Running the multiverse](site/08-multiverse-run.qmd) | Code and execution; [findings](paper/05-findings.qmd) |
| [9. Reconciling the literature](site/09-reconciliation.qmd) | Ten density studies read through the multiverse; 26 recent density, entry-exit and spatial studies weighed against it |
| [10. Where the research goes](site/10-next.qmd) | Open questions, new data, methods and analyses |

Code: [github.com/lecy/multiverse](https://github.com/lecy/multiverse).
Frozen inputs: `s3://lecy/nonprofit-density/inputs/`.
